name: The Jimi Hendrix Experience

whyMatters.en: London-based trio, 1966–1969. Hendrix used feedback, wah, and studio guitar effects as lead tools on Are You Experienced, Axis: Bold as Love, and Electric Ladyland.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦基地三人组，1966–1969。Hendrix 在《Are You Experienced》《Axis: Bold as Love》《Electric Ladyland》上，把反馈、wah 与录音室吉他效果当作主音声部工具。

note.en: 1967 single; tritone riff, fuzz/octave colors, Mitchell fills.
note.zh: 1967 单曲；三全音 riff、fuzz/八度色彩、Mitchell 加花。

note.en: From Electric Ladyland; wah-led blues-rock riff track.
note.zh: 出自《Electric Ladyland》；以 wah 主导的蓝调摇滚 riff 曲。

interviewQuotes.text: Mitch and Noel gave me room to set the guitar on fire—literally and not.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Jimi Hendrix

lyricQuotes: Excuse me while I kiss the sky
Purple haze all in my brain

shortBio.en: London trio, 1966–1969. Hendrix, Redding, Mitchell; Purple Haze and Electric Ladyland are core references.
shortBio.zh: 伦敦三人组，1966–1969。Hendrix、Redding、Mitchell；《Purple Haze》与《Electric Ladyland》是主要参照。

body.en:
The Jimi Hendrix Experience formed in London in 1966 with manager/producer Chas Chandler. Early singles and Are You Experienced (1967) set a psychedelic blues-rock sound; Axis: Bold as Love and Electric Ladyland (1968) added denser studio layering.

Purple Haze (1967) shows original riff writing with effects. All Along the Watchtower (1968), a Bob Dylan song, was rebuilt with layered guitars. Monterey (1967) and Woodstock (1969) performances are widely circulated film and audio documents. The trio period ended in 1969.
body.zh:
The Jimi Hendrix Experience 于 1966 年在伦敦成立，经理/制作人为 Chas Chandler。早期单曲与《Are You Experienced》（1967）定下迷幻蓝调摇滚；《Axis: Bold as Love》与《Electric Ladyland》（1968）增加更密的录音室分层。

《Purple Haze》（1967）展示带效果的原创 riff 写作。《All Along the Watchtower》（1968）翻唱 Bob Dylan，用多层吉他重建。Monterey（1967）与 Woodstock（1969）演出有广泛流传的影像与录音。三人组时期于 1969 年结束。

body.en:
Hendrix treats amp feedback, wah, fuzz, and studio mixing as part of the lead guitar line, alongside blues phrasing and bends.

The trio format leaves space: Mitchell’s jazz-influenced drums and Redding’s bass support without dense chord stacks.
body.zh:
Hendrix 把音箱反馈、wah、fuzz 与录音室混音当作主音吉他线的一部分，与蓝调乐句和推弦并用。

三人编制留出空间：Mitchell 带爵士影响的鼓与 Redding 的贝斯支撑，不堆厚和弦。

body.en:
Released as a single in 1967 and included on Are You Experienced. The opening uses a tritone interval riff; fuzz and octave colors sit on the guitar track; Mitchell adds fills around the vocal.

Runtime stays in pop-single length while the guitar part carries most of the arrangement identity.
body.zh:
1967 年作为单曲发行，并收入《Are You Experienced》。开场使用三全音音程 riff；吉他轨带 fuzz 与八度色彩；Mitchell 在人声周围加花。

时长仍在流行单曲范围，编曲识别主要靠吉他声部。

body.en:
From Electric Ladyland (1968). Wah-pedal articulation leads a blues-rock riff; Mitchell and Redding keep a tight trio pulse underneath.

All Along the Watchtower, also from that album period, rebuilds Dylan’s song with layered studio guitars and a clear dynamic curve.
body.zh:
出自《Electric Ladyland》（1968）。Wah 踏板奏法主导蓝调摇滚 riff；Mitchell 与 Redding 在下方维持紧凑的三人脉冲。

同属该专辑时期的《All Along the Watchtower》用多层录音室吉他与清楚的动态曲线重建 Dylan 原曲。

body.en:
Later hard-rock and metal lead players often cite feedback, wah, and controlled amp noise as melodic tools, not only as accidents.

Jimmy Page and many post-1960s guitarists reference Hendrix’s touch and effect choices alongside blues speed and phrasing.
body.zh:
后来的 hard rock 与金属主音常引用反馈、wah 与可控的音箱噪声作为旋律手段，而不只是意外。

Jimmy Page 与许多 1960 年代后的吉他手，会同时提到 Hendrix 的触感、效果选择与蓝调速度/句式。

body.en:
Interview lines about wanting new sounds line up with the recorded experiments—fuzz, wah, studio overdubs, and live amp volume.

Gear and session detail are more useful than vague praise for describing the Experience records.
body.zh:
关于想要新声音的访谈句，与录音实验一致——fuzz、wah、录音室叠加与现场音箱音量。

描述 Experience 唱片时，设备与录音细节比空泛赞词更有用。

note.en: 1967 single; tritone riff with fuzz and effects as lead color.
note.zh: 1967 单曲；三全音 riff，fuzz 与效果作为主音色彩。

note.en: Feedback, wah, and studio guitar effects used as lead vocabulary in a power trio.
note.zh: 在 power trio 编制中，把反馈、wah 与录音室吉他效果用作主音语汇。

note.en: Hendrix guitar/vocals; Redding bass; Mitchell drums, 1966–1969.
note.zh: Hendrix 吉他/人声；Redding 贝斯；Mitchell 鼓，1966–1969。
